Reviewed every candidate phase at native128px reference height in offscreen Godot;868 focused checks passed. Accepted259 selected H3 frames: move44, attack53, ranged45, defend20, hit26, cast33, death38. Original eight-frame260ms articulated idle retained. Invalid fired-bolt melee, smeared hit and reversing death intervals are excluded; originals retained. Ranged source61-62 with airborne bolt omitted, runtime projectile remains authoritative. Selected frame durations record retiming and shortened holds. No continuous playback, manual game playtest or Linux execution claimed.
